name: millionaire-city-private-server
description: Private server and desktop launcher for Millionaire City 0.501
author: Millionaire City Revival contributors

scripts.build: cmd /c npm run build -w @mcity/shared && npm run build -w @mcity/server && npm run build -w @mcity/desktop
scripts.package:win: cmd /c npm run prepare-client && npm run prepare-runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:dir: cmd /c npm run prepare-client && npm run prepare-runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.typecheck: cmd /c npx tsc -b packages/shared/tsconfig.json apps/server/tsconfig.json apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.lint:cycles: cmd /c npx madge --extensions ts --circular apps/server/src apps/desktop/src packages/shared/src
